debug-copy-lines: The TS logged one DEBUG line per DXMT file copied ('Copying <src> in <dst>'). The engine log has info, warn and error and no debug level, so the Rust port writes no such line; golden_dxmt.rs asserts every DEBUG line of a golden is a 'Copying ' line and skips it. The copy itself is proven by the tree, which holds the eleven files by sha256.
dialog-keys: The backend jest project stubs i18next to return the key, so the download-failure showDialog golden carries box.error.dxmt.title and box.error.dxmt.message. The Rust run resolves them through the catalog; the test loads the English catalog and compares the resolved text to the English of the golden's keys.
error-text: A log line that ends in an error object (Error when downloading dxmt, Error copying wine staging for DXMT version) carried Node's message in the TS: 'Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, copyfile ...' with both paths, or the AxiosError text. The Rust line ends in the OS error kind or the fetch error's category word, which names no path and no URL (T-87-09). golden_dxmt.rs keeps the subject of each such line (its first four or seven words) and ignores what follows.
half-made-copy-removal: The TS removed a half-made <version>-DXMT copy and an uninstalled version's copy with rmSync, wherever installDir pointed. The Rust port removes both through gamelib-safety with <tools>/wine (the copy's own wine directory for a failed copy) as the trust root, so an installDir that does not lie strictly inside the wine directory removes nothing and logs the refusal. No golden carries such a path, so no golden tree differs.
log-prefix: Every golden log line carries the TS prefix ToolInstaller. The engine log is a level and one line and has no prefix field, so the Rust lines carry none; golden_dxmt.rs asserts every golden line is ToolInstaller and compares the level and the message.
offline-boot-returns-early: The TS releasesInfoReady listener went on to copy from <tools>/dxmt after getLatest logged 'App offline' and returned, so an offline boot with no DXMT build installed rejected with ENOENT (boot-fetch-offline) and with one installed recopied the files it already had. on_releases_info keeps that behaviour so the golden replays, and the bounded boot task (boot_update) returns early offline: one warning, no scan, no request, nothing copied and no rejection.
rejection-text: A rejected listener (a release feed answering 500, a feed body with no assets key, a copy into an existing copy that finds no DXMT build) carried Node's error text in the TS ('Request failed with status code 500', "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')", the ENOENT message). The Rust entry points return Err with a category word (tool feed, copy entity not found); the golden pins that it is a rejection and not the text.
